textRuns.value: Values at the end of the period · rates use average headcount, from 2021

measures.name: fmt Dept rate colour
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Termination rate from 2021]
VAR _all = CALCULATE ( [Termination rate from 2021], ALLSELECTED ( 'DataTable'[Department] ) )
RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _r ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _all ) && _r > _all, "#A84545", "#1D2733" )

measures.name: fmt Net change colour
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Net Change]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ) || _n = 0, "#1D2733", IF ( _n < 0, "#A84545", "#026E75" ) )

measures.name: fmt Heatmap font
measures.expression:
VAR _v = [1_Headcount]
VAR _mx = MAXX ( CROSSJOIN ( ALL ( 'DataTable'[Age group] ), ALL ( 'DataTable'[Education level] ) ), [1_Headcount] )
RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _v ) && _v >= 0.7 * _mx, "#FFFFFF", "#1D2733" )
